text.【冲锋】锁定前方路径范围内的一名目标，一定时间内移动速度大幅提升: [Charge] Locks onto a target within range on the path ahead, and gains greatly increased Movement Speed for a period of time

text.多彩盐漠生活: Colorful Life in the Salt Flat

text.多萝西实验失败的产物。: A product of Dorothy's failed experiments.
